claim: Within twenty years Burgundian houses were buying land nearby.
because: Lett planted in 1965; the first Burgundian house to buy in the Dundee Hills was Maison Joseph Drouhin, which established Domaine Drouhin Oregon in 1987, 22 years later (domainedrouhin.com, 'Our Story'). Other Burgundian investment, such as Jadot's Résonance in 2013, came decades after that, so the plural 'houses' within twenty years is also wrong.
fix: Twenty-two years later, in 1987, the Burgundian house of Joseph Drouhin bought land nearby in the Dundee Hills.
